summary: Ford Credit Floorplan Master Owner Trust A filed an 8-K to report the entry into an Underwriting Agreement on May 5, 2026, for the issuance of asset-backed notes. The filing details the offering under a shelf registration, including the required CEO certification under Form SF-3. No price per share, premium, or special-situation terms are disclosed. This is a routine structured finance securitization, not a special situation. The registrants are depositors/sponsors for the ABS issuance, which falls under ordinary capital markets activity.
